question: dame la tasa de aprobación en porcentaje de cada esquema de tarjeta, ordenada de mayor a menor
sql: SELECT card_scheme, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE auth_status = 'approved') / count(*) FROM v_attempt_dedup JOIN dim_card ON v_attempt_dedup.card_sk = dim_card.card_sk WHERE NOT is_test GROUP BY card_scheme ORDER BY 2 DESC
